checks.name: ARD discovery
checks.verification: Fetch ard.json, validate its schema revision, and resolve a listed resource.

checks.name: AI Catalog discovery
checks.verification: Validate ai-catalog.json independently from ARD; verify consumer compatibility.

checks.name: ARD entry validity
checks.verification: Validate every entry and invoke its linked capability using the native protocol.

checks.name: ARD trust manifest
checks.verification: Verify issuer, subject, publisher binding, expiry, and signatures under the declared framework.

checks.name: Category share of voice
checks.verification: Record category queries, engine, region, date, and returned citations; compare repeated samples.

checks.name: Developer resource discoverability
checks.verification: Search for the intended integration task and confirm official documentation is reachable.

checks.name: Brand name discoverability
checks.verification: Check brand queries resolve to the correct organization and domain.

checks.name: Wikipedia / Wikidata entity presence
checks.verification: Check existing entities and independent sources; verify P856 only on the correct eligible entity.

checks.name: Sitemap exists
checks.verification: Fetch and parse the sitemap; follow representative canonical URLs.

checks.name: Content without JavaScript
checks.verification: Fetch initial HTML without JavaScript and confirm the core content and headings are present.

checks.name: Not blocked by bot detection
checks.verification: Test the deployed CDN response for intended agents and investigate challenges or blocked content.

checks.name: robots.txt AI crawler policy
checks.verification: Compare declared training and retrieval policies with intended access and actual responses.

checks.name: Agent discovery file
checks.verification: Read the served discovery file and follow its capability links; reject HTML fallback pages.

checks.name: Agent Skills index conformance (v0.2.0)
checks.verification: Validate the claimed index version and fetch every advertised skill entry.

checks.name: A2A / agent-card
checks.verification: Validate the card against the supported A2A revision and exercise its advertised endpoint.

checks.name: Listed in MCP registries
checks.verification: Find the official registry record and verify publisher, endpoint, and real client connection.

checks.name: NPM/PyPI SDK package
checks.verification: Install the official package in a clean consumer and run its documented request.

checks.name: Agent platform configs
checks.verification: Verify linked repository instructions match supported harnesses and repository behavior.

checks.name: Agent Plugins manifest
checks.verification: Validate the target platform manifest and install the real plugin; filenames alone are insufficient.

checks.name: Listed on skills.sh
checks.verification: Resolve the official listing to the maintained skill and confirm installation.

checks.name: pricing.md exists
checks.verification: Compare pricing.md with live offers, currency, billing units, limits, and regional terms.

checks.name: NLWeb Schema Feeds
checks.verification: Follow schemamap from robots.txt; validate the map, feed records, updates, and deletions.

checks.name: MCP well-known discovery
checks.verification: Resolve discovery metadata to a working MCP endpoint and verify its transport.

checks.name: Agent mode view
checks.verification: Compare the alternative with the ordinary view for content, permissions, and useful task support.

checks.name: HTTP Link headers (RFC 8288)
checks.verification: Inspect HTTP Link relations and fetch their targets with the advertised media types.

checks.name: Markdown URL fallback
checks.verification: Request the documented .md URL including the homepage fallback and verify real Markdown.

checks.name: Modular llms.txt per product area
checks.verification: Follow root-to-section indexes and confirm coverage, bounded size, and working links.

checks.name: Registry branding
checks.verification: Match name, publisher, domain, description, and artwork to the official product.

checks.name: ChatGPT app listed
checks.verification: Verify the actual directory listing and launch the supported app experience.

checks.name: Sitemap freshness (lastmod)
checks.verification: Compare lastmod values with substantive source changes rather than request time.

checks.name: robots.txt agent-user policy
checks.verification: Separate user-invoked retrieval from training policy and test intended agent access.

checks.name: llms.txt exists
checks.verification: Fetch llms.txt anonymously and verify content type and actual document content.

checks.name: llms.txt formatting
checks.verification: Check heading, summary, organized Markdown links, descriptions, and parsing.

checks.name: JSON-LD structured data
checks.verification: Parse JSON-LD and compare its entities and claims with visible source content.

checks.name: Pricing info accessible
checks.verification: Locate authoritative prices and terms without guessing from marketing copy.

checks.name: Public API/docs linked from homepage
checks.verification: Follow homepage links to usable API docs and a contract matching the deployed endpoint.

checks.name: Agent instruction / when-to-use
checks.verification: Verify task fit, limits, prerequisites, and a runnable first action are explicit.

checks.name: Skills.sh skill quality
checks.verification: Read installed instructions, linked resources, and an actual successful workflow.

checks.name: JSON-LD entity linking (sameAs)
checks.verification: Verify sameAs targets identify the same entity rather than unrelated mentions.

checks.name: MCP tool descriptions
checks.verification: Use descriptions to choose the right tool for a real task and reject misleading side effects.

checks.name: MCP parameter schemas
checks.verification: Validate required fields, types, bounds, and invalid input through the running server.

checks.name: MCP server identity
checks.verification: Confirm the protocol-appropriate server identity matches its advertised product and version.

checks.name: Metadata completeness
checks.verification: Check title, description, canonical URL, and social metadata against page content.

checks.name: Organization schema completeness
checks.verification: Verify real organization details; do not invent addresses or contact points.

checks.name: Schema type breadth
checks.verification: Use only justified schema types; compare products, FAQs, and ratings with visible evidence.

checks.name: Trust anchor pages
checks.verification: Visit About, Contact, and Privacy pages and verify their ownership and usefulness.

checks.name: MCP tool listing
checks.verification: Enumerate tools with a compatible client and follow pagination where present.

checks.name: MCP tool naming
checks.verification: Check protocol and adapter name constraints, uniqueness, and understandable task semantics.

checks.name: llms.txt links resolve
checks.verification: Fetch every linked target and detect login redirects, stale links, and soft 404s.

checks.name: Markdown alternate link
checks.verification: Follow HTML or HTTP alternate links and compare the content of each twin.

checks.name: Markdown frontmatter metadata
checks.verification: Parse frontmatter and check title, source URL, and freshness against the canonical page.

checks.name: Redirect hygiene
checks.verification: Inspect redirect chains for loops, lost paths, changed origins, and misleading successful fallbacks.

checks.name: Page token budget
checks.verification: Measure the representation an agent receives and split excessive navigation or unrelated material.

checks.name: Code fence validity
checks.verification: Parse fence boundaries and language tags, then run the intended example where practical.

checks.name: Content behind auth
checks.verification: Confirm public docs stay public and protected docs retain intentional authorization.

checks.name: Public API with reachable endpoints
checks.verification: Make a safe real request and inspect the response; a marketing API mention is insufficient.

checks.name: OpenAPI spec published
checks.verification: Validate the fetched OpenAPI document and execute a declared operation against the live server.

checks.name: OAuth 2.0 support
checks.verification: Complete the supported authorization flow and reject invalid tokens; public reads may need no OAuth.

checks.name: Scoped permissions
checks.verification: Exercise insufficient and sufficient scopes without broadening caller privileges.

checks.name: Developer portal
checks.verification: Navigate from discovery to credentials if required, a first request, and recovery guidance.

checks.name: MCP auth mechanism
checks.verification: Connect with the supported credential mechanism and verify unauthenticated denial.

checks.name: MCP OAuth metadata
checks.verification: Resolve resource metadata to the correct authorization server and validate issuer binding.

checks.name: MCP PKCE S256 support
checks.verification: Verify S256 is advertised and enforced; reject missing or incorrect verifier values.

checks.name: MPP payment protocol
checks.verification: Exercise complete challenge, verified payment, receipt, and retry behavior in a test environment.

checks.name: x402 payment protocol
checks.verification: Verify unpaid challenge, supported settlement, delivery, and duplicate-payment handling.

checks.name: Agent onboarding friction
checks.verification: Follow documented steps with a fresh allowed identity and record required human intervention.

checks.name: Web Bot Auth directory
checks.verification: Resolve signing-key metadata and verify a real signature, expiry, and replay handling.

checks.name: API catalog (RFC 9727)
checks.verification: Validate the API Catalog linkset and follow its service-description links.

checks.name: OAuth Protected Resource metadata (RFC 9728)
checks.verification: Fetch metadata on the resource origin and confirm resource and authorization_servers reflect reality.

checks.name: UCP - Universal Commerce Protocol
checks.verification: Exercise supported discovery, catalog, checkout, authorization, and order state with the intended client.

checks.name: ACP - Agentic Commerce Protocol
checks.verification: Verify the supported checkout contract and complete an authorized sandbox journey.

checks.name: ACP delegate payment
checks.verification: Verify delegated payment scope and expiry, rejection cases, and reconciliation.

checks.name: AP2 - Agent Payments Protocol
checks.verification: Verify mandate identity, amount, merchant, expiry, revocation, and enforcement in the payment path.

checks.name: auth.md exists
checks.verification: Read the real root document; distinguish public access policy from an implemented registration protocol.

checks.name: auth.md structure
checks.verification: Check required workflow content and endpoints against the protocol revision being claimed.

checks.name: auth.md walkthrough simulation
checks.verification: Run the allowed onboarding path without fabricated endpoints or unsupported identity types.

checks.name: Agent auth discovery metadata
checks.verification: Validate AS metadata, identity enum, nested assertion types, identity endpoint, and skill link.

checks.name: Agent auth WWW-Authenticate hint
checks.verification: Inspect a real 401 and resolve its Bearer resource_metadata challenge.

checks.name: agent_auth endpoints reachable
checks.verification: Check methods, schemas, status codes, and authorization behavior at every advertised URI.

checks.name: MCP server / manifest
checks.verification: Connect with the advertised revision and call a useful tool through its actual transport.

checks.name: MCP error handling
checks.verification: Trigger a safe invalid request and verify structured protocol or tool errors with recovery guidance.

checks.name: MCP modern transport
checks.verification: Check the supported transport and revision with target clients instead of inferring from route names.

checks.name: WebMCP support
checks.verification: Inspect registration and invoke a tool in a supporting browser; preserve ordinary UI fallback.

checks.name: Markdown agent docs
checks.verification: Request text/markdown and verify actual content, status, and correct response media type.

checks.name: Markdown content negotiation (acceptmarkdown.com)
checks.verification: Test HTML and Markdown through cache and verify Vary: Accept prevents cross-serving.

checks.name: Rate limit response headers
checks.verification: Observe quota information and a controlled 429 with usable retry timing.

checks.name: Idempotency-Key support
checks.verification: Repeat the same allowed mutation key and confirm one effect; reject conflicting payload reuse.

checks.name: JSON error responses
checks.verification: Request invalid input and missing resources; verify JSON status, code, message, and recovery guidance.

checks.name: REST typed error model
checks.verification: Validate actual failure bodies against the published error schema and status contract.

checks.name: REST versioning / deprecation policy
checks.verification: Verify announced deprecations, replacement guidance, and old-client behavior.

checks.name: REST pagination pattern
checks.verification: Traverse multiple pages, empty results, and invalid cursors with documented ordering and limits.

checks.name: REST async-job pattern
checks.verification: Follow the returned job identity to terminal success or failure without duplicate submission.

checks.name: CLI tool available
checks.verification: Install and run a noninteractive command with structured output and meaningful exit status.

checks.name: Multi-language SDK packages
checks.verification: Install each claimed SDK and run the same documented request; do not infer support from package names.

checks.name: NLWeb /ask endpoint
checks.verification: Send the supported request and validate structured results and source URLs.

checks.name: NLWeb streaming support
checks.verification: Inspect actual events, result delivery, cancellation, completion, and error behavior.

checks.name: REST response schema coverage
checks.verification: Compare real success and error responses for documented operations with media-type-specific schemas.

checks.name: MCP tool annotations
checks.verification: Verify advisory safety hints match actual effects; enforce permissions independently.

checks.name: MCP server-card.json
checks.verification: Fetch the card, check identity and transport, and connect to the declared server.

checks.name: Product + docs MCP coverage
checks.verification: Exercise both an actual product operation and docs retrieval; assess separation by permission and audience needs.

checks.name: Sandbox / test environment
checks.verification: Verify isolated test credentials, data, reset behavior, and absence of production side effects.

checks.name: REST batch / bulk endpoint
checks.verification: Test limits, atomicity, per-item errors, mixed results, and duplicate submissions.

checks.name: MCP resources exposed
checks.verification: List and read resources with the supported client and check access boundaries.

checks.name: GraphQL typed error model
checks.verification: Exercise domain and resolver failures; distinguish partial data from complete operation success.

checks.name: GraphQL versioning / deprecation policy
checks.verification: Inspect field deprecations and migration policy and run an existing client's query.

checks.name: GraphQL pagination pattern
checks.verification: Traverse cursors and pageInfo or the documented alternative including terminal state.

checks.name: GraphQL async-job pattern
checks.verification: Follow a typed job result through status queries and terminal outcomes.

checks.name: GraphQL schema description coverage
checks.verification: Inspect published schema descriptions, arguments, nullability, enums, and authorization limits.

checks.name: GraphQL batch mutations
checks.verification: Verify bounded item inputs, per-item outcomes, permissions, and retry behavior.

checks.name: Bot-UA markdown serving
checks.verification: Check content and authorization parity; user-agent strings must not grant trust or access.

checks.name: Agent-friendly 404s
checks.verification: Request a missing path and verify a real 404 with useful recovery links or structured API guidance.

checks.name: Accessible document structure
checks.verification: Inspect landmarks and heading order in the actual accessibility tree.

checks.name: Native interactive controls
checks.verification: Operate controls by role and keyboard and verify their intended effects.

checks.name: Accessible names on controls
checks.verification: Check computed control names against visible purpose, including icon buttons.

checks.name: Form control labeling
checks.verification: Verify label association, instructions, validation, and focus during submission.

checks.name: Accessibility-tree injection safety (bonus)
checks.verification: Compare accessible and visible content for injected instructions without stripping legitimate accessibility help.

checks.name: MCP Apps support
checks.verification: Discover UI resource metadata and launch it in a compatible host.

checks.name: A2UI / generative UI support
checks.verification: Render a real structured UI message through the intended renderer and validate allowed actions.

checks.name: MCP Apps UI quality
checks.verification: Exercise loading, empty, error, resize, accessibility, and task-completion states in the host.

checks.name: MCP App view reachable
checks.verification: Open the declared view and verify origin, authentication, assets, and rendering.

checks.name: MCP App view CSP
checks.verification: Check declared network and resource policies against actual permitted and blocked requests.

checks.name: API schema complexity analysis
checks.verification: Review recursive types, unions, enums, and nesting against client parsing and task size.

checks.name: Agent crawler reachability
checks.verification: Check actual responses for intended crawlers across CDN, robots policy, and canonical hosts.

checks.name: Function calling compatibility
checks.verification: Validate generated schemas and a real call with the intended provider and runtime.

checks.name: MCP resource quality
checks.verification: Verify names, descriptions, media types, stable URIs, useful content, and freshness.
